title: LAILA SHAHEED HO GAYA TERA JAWAA'N PISAR
body:
Ghodo'n se jab gira Shahe Mazloom ka Pisar
Khaime ki simt Shah ne Dekha ba chashme tar
Laila pukaari kya hai MereLaal ki khabar
Bekas Hussain kehne lage dil ko thaam kar
<<MINI>>
Laila Shaheed ho gaya Tera Jawa'n Pisar
<<DIVIDER>>
Laila sab hasrato'n ke janaaze nikal gaye
Hathyaar saare Akbare mehru pa chal gaye
Sehre ke phool khoon ki dhaaron me dhal gaye
Naize se chhid gaya Tere farzand ka jigar
<<MINI>>
Laila Shaheed ho gaya Tera Jawa'n Pisar
<<DIVIDER>>
Laila Hamara mannato'n Waala guzar gaya
Duniya Hamare chain ki barbaad kar gaya
Chehra wo chaand se bhi hasee'n khu'n me bhar gaya
Ab be chiragh hogaya Laila hamara ghar
<<MINI>>
Laila Shaheed ho gaya Tera Jawa'n Pisar
<<DIVIDER>>
Gham se ghareeb Baap ka dil paash paash hai
Beenaai ja chuki hai Pisar ki taLaash hai
Narghe me ahle zulm ke Bete ki Laash hai
Bas meHamara dil hai na qaabu me hai nazar
<<MINI>>
Laila Shaheed ho gaya Tera Jawa'n Pisar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch rehm Mere haal pa khaata nahi'n koi
Bekas ko raasta bhi dikhata nahi koi
Kis ja hai MeraLaalbataata nahi koi
Rote hain hamPisar ko to hanste hain ahle shar
<<MINI>>
Laila Shaheed ho gaya Tera Jawa'n Pisar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaweed tha azeem Ghame Shaahe Mashraqain
Marge Pisar se lut gaya Sarwar ke dil ka chain
Ghode se jab zamee'n pa gira Dilbare Hussain
Rone lage ye keh ke Shahinshaahe Behro Bar
<<MINI>>
Laila Shaheed ho gaya Tera Jawa'n Pisar
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
